audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-024: Do corrupted withdrawal instructions from the consensus layer fail validation before crediting amounts?
audit_items.reason: This check concerns the execution client's validation of withdrawal instructions received via Engine API, specifically withdrawals_root validation before crediting balances. While Teku sends withdrawals to the EL via Engine API (e.g., in processWithdrawals at BlockProcessorElectra.java:202-213), the actual withdrawals_root validation and balance crediting happens in the execution client. Teku computes expected withdrawals and passes them to the EL payload, but does not implement the EL-side integrity check being tested.
